evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Garantizar la calidad, trazabilidad y gobierno del dato mediante tests y reconciliaciones.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities emphasize data quality, traceability, governance, and testing/reconciliation throughout with no velocity/speed language present.
evidence.domain_risk: servirá como base para analítica avanzada, automatización e inteligencia artificial
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: No explicit financial reporting, regulatory, or compliance language; the platform serves internal analytics and AI foundations with business-decision consequences rather than default-high sector risk.
evidence.collaboration_width: equipo de Tecnología y Analítica; Producto; Marketing, Operaciones y Negocio
evidence.data_team_maturity: diseñar y construir una plataforma de datos desde cero
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Explicit 'build from zero' framing (desde cero, no buscamos a alguien que venga a mantener una plataforma, buscamos a la persona que quiera construirla) signals an early-stage data function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Diseñar y desplegar la infraestructura en AWS utilizando Terraform (Infrastructure as Code).
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Highly specific named tools and architecture patterns (Medallion architecture, SCD2, CDC, dbt-athena) make the day-to-day work unambiguous.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Colaborar con los equipos de Producto, Tecnología y Analítica para convertir los datos en una ventaja competitiva.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role's primary audience is the internal data/technology function building the platform itself, though it serves downstream Product/Marketing/Operations teams.
evidence.autonomy_level: Liderar técnicamente el desarrollo de nuestro nuevo Data Lake corporativo.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Strong strategic verbs (liderar, diseñar, participar en decisiones de arquitectura) with explicit ownership framing throughout (tomar decisiones, proponer mejoras, trabajando con autonomía).
evidence.ai_role_explanation: Inteligencia artificial is mentioned only as a future downstream use case for the Data Lake platform, not a skill or infrastructure requirement expected of the candidate today.
evidence.testing_framing: Garantizar la calidad, trazabilidad y gobierno del dato mediante tests y reconciliaciones.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing and reconciliation are framed as an owned responsibility with an action verb (garantizar) rather than only appearing in a tool list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Garantizar la calidad, trazabilidad y gobierno del dato mediante tests y reconciliaciones.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Moderate: concern centers on data quality, traceability, and governance rather than explicit regulatory or compliance risk language.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: diseñar y construir una plataforma de datos desde cero
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Explicitly building a brand-new Data Lake platform (CORTEX) from scratch with no existing infrastructure to fix or scale.
